# POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD v0.1 Recovery Brief

Status: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`; separate quarantined
recovery not launched

## Objective

Recover an implementation-independent scientific record for the mature
numerical point estimator
`POINT-FIT/ELLIPTICAL-GAUSSIAN-COMPATIBILITY@1`. Recovery evidence may be
inspected only under the separate recovery task's explicit authorization. The
Stage B author receives only the sanitized, owner-reviewed record.

## Required Record

The returned record shall bind:

- the exact zero-background Gaussian equation, amplitude meaning, centroid
  basis, invariant shape representation, published width convention,
  principal-axis ordering, angle gauge/period/circularity behavior, bounds,
  and bound interpretation;
- admitted fit rows, residual vector, scalar objective or likelihood, fit
  weight identity/source/unit/support/normalization/lifecycle, relationship to
  stochastic covariance, non-finite/zero/conflict behavior, and solution
  comparison rule;
- expected source position versus algorithmic search center, central-search
  domain, peak score and weights, candidate population, interpolation, tie
  rule, parameter initialization, fallback trigger/domain, post-fallback
  source association, support motion, and requested/effective/resolved/applied/
  realized branch identity; and
- constraints, solver-independent solution rule, local-minimum disposition,
  termination/convergence, retries, active bounds, rank/identifiability,
  sentinel resolution, failures, immutable method/generation identity, and
  whether the result preserves a path-dependent compatibility procedure or
  defines a new successor.

## Classification Of Every Recovered Fact

Each fact shall be labeled as exact established compatibility behavior,
scientific interpretation, representation/solver detail, historical behavior
not promotable to authority, or unresolved owner decision. Unresolved science
must be returned to the owner; it must not be guessed.

## Release Gate

The method remains unavailable until its exact sanitized bytes, method
identity, compatibility/supersession state, and digest receive explicit
scientific-owner approval. Until then `SCI-POINT-UNAV-004` controls every
numerical compatibility-fit product and dependent claim.
